installation.content:
#!/bin/bash
#
##---------------------------------------------
## henwoodenator's UT99 Pelican install script
##---------------------------------------------
## GAME:        UT99 w/ Chaos
## DATE:        Mar-Jun 2026
## PLATFORM:    Pelican Panel
## AUTHOR:      henwoodenator / drPyro / mister_apocalypse
## CONTAINER:   Installer container ghcr.io/pelican-eggs/yolks:debian
##              Running container ghcr.io/pelican-eggs/steamcmd:debian
#
## DESCRIPTION: UT99 Install script for Pelican Panel. May also work with Pterodactyl 
#               but untested. Downloads UT99 files, patches it, adds bonus packs, mutators etc. 
#               
#               The original idea was to create a UT99 server that could run from standard Pelican
#               panel images, both to deploy and run. Required a bit more complexity in the
#               install script, but makes it easy to setup.
#
## CREDITS:     Much of this script is adapted from the github roemer UT99 image, all credit to him
#               I've just adapted it to work in a Pelican / Pterodactyl panel environment. Ideally 
#               I'd fork the repo & point all my things there, but later maybe. Thanks to all the
#               random UT99 & UT2004 forks, including GFXSpeed. They helped me understand how to 
#               write this install script.
#               https://hub.docker.com/r/roemer/ut99-server https://github.com/Roemer/ut99-server
#               https://github.com/GFXSpeed/ut2004_pterodactyl
##---------------------------------------------
#
## Uncomment the below line if you want full verbose console output
#set -x
#
##---------------------------------------------
## INSTALL PREREQUSITES ##
##---------------------------------------------
apt install bzip2
cd /mnt/server
##---------------------------------------------
## DOWNLOAD & APPLY GAME/PATCH/BONUSPACKS/MUTATORS ##
##---------------------------------------------
echo '[1/7] Base server'
#wget -O ut-server.tar.gz https://github.com/IceOfWraith/UT99-Linux/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz
wget -O ut-server.tar.gz https://raw.githubusercontent.com/henwoodenator/ut99-pelican-egg/main/files/ut-server-linux-436.tar.gz
tar -xzf ut-server.tar.gz
cp -r ut-server/* ./
rm -rf ut-server ut-server.tar.gz

echo '[2/7] Patch 469e'
wget -O ut469e_64.tar.bz2 https://github.com/OldUnreal/UnrealTournamentPatches/releases/download/v469e/OldUnreal-UTPatch469e-Linux-amd64.tar.bz2
wget -O ut469e_x86.tar.bz2 https://github.com/OldUnreal/UnrealTournamentPatches/releases/download/v469e/OldUnreal-UTPatch469e-Linux-x86.tar.bz2
tar -xf ut469e_64.tar.bz2
tar -xf ut469e_x86.tar.bz2
rm ut469e_64.tar.bz2
rm ut469e_x86.tar.bz2

echo '[3/7] Bonus packs 1-4'
wget -O bp1.tar.gz https://raw.githubusercontent.com/henwoodenator/ut99-pelican-egg/main/files/UTBonusPack1.tar.gz
wget -O bp2.tar.gz https://raw.githubusercontent.com/henwoodenator/ut99-pelican-egg/main/files/UTBonusPack2.tar.gz
wget -O bp3.tar.gz https://raw.githubusercontent.com/henwoodenator/ut99-pelican-egg/main/files/UTBonusPack3.tar.gz
wget -O bp4.tar.gz https://raw.githubusercontent.com/henwoodenator/ut99-pelican-egg/main/files/UTBonusPack4.tar.gz
tar -xzf bp1.tar.gz
tar -xzf bp2.tar.gz
tar -xzf bp3.tar.gz
tar -xzf bp4.tar.gz
rm -f bp*.tar.gz

echo '[4/7] Mutators'
#MapVoteLA13
wget -O mapvote.zip https://unreal-archive-files-na.s3.ca-east-tor.io.cloud.ovh.net/Unreal%20Tournament/Mutators/M/8/8/c441c8/MapvoteLA13.zip
unzip -o mapvote.zip
rm -f mapvote.zip

#FlagAnnouncementsV2
wget -O flagann.tar.gz https://raw.githubusercontent.com/henwoodenator/ut99-pelican-egg/main/files/Mutators/FlagAnnouncementsV2.tar.gz
tar -xzf flagann.tar.gz
rm -f flagann.tar.gz

#Kick Idle Players
wget -O kip.tar.gz https://raw.githubusercontent.com/henwoodenator/ut99-pelican-egg/main/files/Mutators/KickIdlePlayers2.tar.gz
tar -xzf kip.tar.gz
rm -f kip.tar.gz

#WhoPushedMe
wget -O wpm.tar.gz https://raw.githubusercontent.com/henwoodenator/ut99-pelican-egg/main/files/Mutators/WhoPushedMe.tar.gz
tar -xzf wpm.tar.gz
rm -f wpm.tar.gz

echo '[5/7] Mods'
#Chaos UT
wget -O chaosut.tar.gz https://raw.githubusercontent.com/henwoodenator/ut99-pelican-egg/main/files/Mods/chaosut_v1.1.tar.gz
tar -xzf chaosut.tar.gz
rm -f chaosut.tar.gz

#MonsterHunt
wget -O monsterhunt.tar.gz https://raw.githubusercontent.com/henwoodenator/ut99-pelican-egg/main/files/Mods/MonsterHunt613.tar.gz
tar -xzf monsterhunt.tar.gz
rm -f monsterhunt.tar.gz

#InstaGibPlus
wget -O igp.tar.gz https://raw.githubusercontent.com/henwoodenator/ut99-pelican-egg/main/files/Mutators/InstaGibPlus_10B.tar.gz
tar -xzf igp.tar.gz
rm -f igp.tar.gz

#BunnyTrack
wget -O btpp.tar.gz https://raw.githubusercontent.com/henwoodenator/ut99-pelican-egg/main/files/Mods/BTPlusPlusPublicUTBT_beta3.tar.gz
tar -xzf btpp.tar.gz
rm -f btpp.tar.gz

echo '[6/7] Maps'
wget -O chaosmaps-1.tar.gz https://raw.githubusercontent.com/henwoodenator/ut99-pelican-egg/main/files/Maps-Packed/chaosut_gotymappack.tar.gz
wget -O chaosmaps-2.tar.gz https://raw.githubusercontent.com/henwoodenator/ut99-pelican-egg/main/files/Maps-Packed/chaosut_beta4mappack.tar.gz
tar -xzf chaosmaps-1.tar.gz
tar -xzf chaosmaps-2.tar.gz
rm -f chaosmaps-*.tar.gz

#BunnyTrack maps
wget -O bt-maps-feb.tar.gz https://raw.githubusercontent.com/henwoodenator/ut99-pelican-egg/main/files/Maps-Packed/FEB-Classic-BT-Map-Pack.tar.gz
wget -O bt-maps-hammerize.tar.gz https://raw.githubusercontent.com/henwoodenator/ut99-pelican-egg/main/files/Maps-Packed/CTF-BT-Hammerize.tar.gz
tar -xzf bt-maps-feb.tar.gz
tar -xzf bt-maps-hammerize.tar.gz
rm -f bt-maps-*.tar.gz

##---------------------------------------------
## MAKE BINARIES EXECUTABLE ##
##---------------------------------------------
echo '[7/7] Config'
chmod +x System/ucc-bin-x86
chmod +x System64/ucc-bin-amd64

## Fix libSDL-1.2.so missing library error
## Not needed if using the amd64 binary, but this gets the x86 one working
ln -s System/libSDL-1.1.so.0 System/libSDL-1.2.so.0

##---------------------------------------------
## CREATE UT99_START.SH SCRIPT ##
##---------------------------------------------
echo 'Creating ut99_start.sh script'
cat << 'EOF' > ut99_start.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
##---------------------------------------------
## henwoodenator's UT99 Pelican start script
##---------------------------------------------
## GAME:        UT99 w/ Chaos
## DATE:        Mar-Jun 2026
## PLATFORM:    Pelican Panel
## AUTHOR:      henwoodenator / drPyro / mister_apocalypse
#
## DESCRIPTION: Copies variables into both config files & starts server. Almost everything that
#               needs to be a variable has been passed. Uses awk as sed was getting a bit crazy
#               (a-la me not being smart enough), and the INI file has too many duplicate names
#               under different sections for json updating via the panel UI.
#
## CREDITS:     Much of this script is adapted from the github roemer UT99 image, all credit to him
#               I've just adapted it to work in a Pelican / Pterodactyl panel environment. Ideally 
#               I'd fork the repo & point all my things there, but later maybe. Thanks to all the
#               random UT99 & UT2004 forks, including GFXSpeed. They helped me understand how to 
#               write the install script.
##---------------------------------------------
## Uncomment the below 2x lines if you want full verbose console output
#set -x
#set -euo pipefail
#
## Copy the default *.ini files to the home/container dir
cp System/UnrealTournament.ini.PATCH $HOME/UT.ini
cp System/User.ini $HOME/UTUser.ini
#
## Set variables for ini locations to make scripting easier
CONFIG="$HOME/UT.ini"
USERCFG="$HOME/UTUser.ini"
#
#------------------------------------------------
## DEFINE LOGIC ##
#------------------------------------------------
## ini_set - Updates key, will add section & key if missing
## EXAMPLE: ini_set "$CONFIG" "IpDrv.TcpNetDriver" "NetServerMaxTickRate" "30"
ini_set() {
    # Add/update key, create section if missing
    local file="$1"
    local section="$2"
    local key="$3"
    local value="$4"

    awk -v section="$section" -v key="$key" -v value="$value" '
    BEGIN { in_section=0; found=0; section_found=0 }

    # Enter target section
    $0 ~ "^\\[" section "\\][[:space:]]*$" {
        in_section=1
        found=0
        section_found=1
        print
        next
    }

    # Any new section ends current one
    /^\[/ && in_section {
        if (!found) print key "=" value
        in_section=0
    }

    # Replace key
    in_section && $0 ~ "^[[:space:]]*" key "=" {
        print key "=" value
        found=1
        next
    }

    { print }

    END {
        if (in_section && !found) {
            print key "=" value
        }
        if (!section_found) {
            print ""
            print "[" section "]"
            print key "=" value
        }
    }
    ' "$file" > "$file.tmp" && mv "$file.tmp" "$file"
}
## ini_delete_key - Deletes a key inside a specified section
## EXAMPLE: ini_delete_key "$CONFIG" "IpDrv.TcpNetDriver" "SimLatency"
ini_delete_key() {
    # Delete a key ONLY inside a section
    local file="$1"
    local section="$2"
    local key="$3"

    awk -v section="$section" -v key="$key" '
    BEGIN { in_section=0 }

    $0 ~ "^\\[" section "\\][[:space:]]*$" {
        in_section=1
        print
        next
    }

    /^\[/ && in_section {
        in_section=0
    }

    # Skip matching key inside section
    in_section && $0 ~ "^[[:space:]]*" key "=" {
        next
    }

    { print }
    ' "$file" > "$file.tmp" && mv "$file.tmp" "$file"
}
## ini_add_section - Adds empty section if not exist. Called by ini_set
## EXAMPLE: ini_add_section "$CONFIG" "NewSection"
ini_add_section() {
    # Add section if it doesn't exist
    local file="$1"
    local section="$2"

    if ! grep -q "^\[$section\]" "$file"; then
        printf "\n[%s]\n" "$section" >> "$file"
    fi
}
## ini_add_array_value - For sections that use an array with multiple identical named entries
##    i.e. ServerActors below
## EXAMPLE: ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "IpDrv.TcpNetDriver" "DownloadManagers" "My.NewManager"
ini_add_array_value() {
    local file="$1"
    local section="$2"
    local key="$3"
    local value="$4"

    awk -v section="$section" -v key="$key" -v value="$value" '
    BEGIN { in_section=0; exists=0 }

    $0 ~ "^\\[" section "\\][[:space:]]*$" {
        in_section=1
        print
        next
    }

    /^\[/ && in_section {
        if (!exists) print key "=" value
        in_section=0
    }

    in_section && $0 == key "=" value {
        exists=1
    }

    { print }

    END {
        if (in_section && !exists) {
            print key "=" value
        }
    }
    ' "$file" > "$file.tmp" && mv "$file.tmp" "$file"
}
## ini_remove_array_value - Opposite of add. Removes values which have duplicate names
## EXAMPLE: ini_remove_array_value "$CONFIG" "IpDrv.TcpNetDriver" "DownloadManagers" "IpDrv.HTTPDownload"
ini_remove_array_value() {
    local file="$1"
    local section="$2"
    local key="$3"
    local value="$4"

    awk -v section="$section" -v key="$key" -v value="$value" '
    BEGIN { in_section=0 }

    $0 ~ "^\\[" section "\\][[:space:]]*$" {
        in_section=1
        print
        next
    }

    /^\[/ && in_section {
        in_section=0
    }

    in_section && $0 == key "=" value {
        next
    }

    { print }
    ' "$file" > "$file.tmp" && mv "$file.tmp" "$file"
}
#
#------------------------------------------------
## SET VARIABLES / VALUES ##
#------------------------------------------------
## Server Name, Admin details
ini_set "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameReplicationInfo" "ServerName" "${SERVER_NAME}"
ini_set "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameReplicationInfo" "AdminName" "${ADMIN_NAME}"
ini_set "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameReplicationInfo" "AdminEmail" "${ADMIN_EMAIL}"
ini_set "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameReplicationInfo" "Region" "11"
ini_set "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameReplicationInfo" "MOTDLine1" "${MOTD}"
ini_set "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameReplicationInfo" "ShortName" "${SV_SHORTNAME}"
#
## Check if password protect is set & set
if [ -n "${GAME_PASSWORD}" ]; then
    ini_set "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameInfo" "GamePassword" "${GAME_PASSWORD}"
fi
#
## Faster Downloads?
if [ -n \"${FASTDL_URL}\" ]; then
  ini_set "$CONFIG" "IpDrv.HTTPDownload" "RedirectToURL" "${FASTDL_URL}"
  ini_set "$CONFIG" "IpDrv.HTTPDownload" "UseCompression" "True"
fi
#
## Remove standard master servers
sed -i '/^\[Engine\.GameEngine\][[:space:]]*$/,/^\[.*\]/ {
    /^[[:space:]]*ServerActors=.*MasterServerAddress=/d
}' "$CONFIG"
#
## Add aftermarket master server actors (i.e. master server uplink) in (openspy,333networks etc)
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerActors" "IpServer.UdpServerUplink MasterServerAddress=master.333networks.com MasterServerPort=27900"
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerActors" "IpServer.UdpServerUplink MasterServerAddress=master.qtracker.com MasterServerPort=27900"
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerActors" "IpServer.UdpServerUplink MasterServerAddress=master.newbiesplayground.net MasterServerPort=28900"
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerActors" "IpServer.UdpServerUplink MasterServerAddress=master.errorist.eu MasterServerPort=27900"
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerActors" "IpServer.UdpServerUplink MasterServerAddress=master.openspy.net MasterServerPort=27900"
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerActors" "IpServer.UdpServerUplink MasterServerAddress=master.oldunreal.com MasterServerPort=27900"
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerActors" "IpServer.UdpServerUplink MasterServerAddress=master2.oldunreal.com MasterServerPort=27900"
#
## Enable advertisement on master servers
ini_set "$CONFIG" "IpServer.UdpServerUplink" "DoUpLink" "True"
ini_set "$CONFIG" "IpServer.UdpServerUplink" "UpdateMinutes" "1"

## Performance - Up the max tick rate
ini_set "$CONFIG" "IpDrv.TcpNetDriver" "NetServerMaxTickRate" "30"
#
## Enable the web server on specified port & set variables
ini_set "$CONFIG" "UWeb.WebServer" "ListenPort" "${WEBADMIN_PORT}"
ini_set "$CONFIG" "UWeb.WebServer" "bEnabled" "True"
ini_set "$CONFIG" "UTServerAdmin.UTServerAdmin" "AdminUsername" "${WEBADMIN_USER}"
ini_set "$CONFIG" "UTServerAdmin.UTServerAdmin" "AdminPassword" "${WEBADMIN_PASS}"
#
## Add some bots by default
## DM ##
ini_set "$CONFIG" "Botpack.DeathMatchPlus" "MinPlayers" "${DM_MIN_PLAYERS}"
ini_set "$CONFIG" "Botpack.DeathMatchPlus" "InitialBots" "4"
## CTF ##
ini_set "$CONFIG" "Botpack.CTFGame" "MinPlayers" "${CTF_MIN_PLAYERS}"
ini_set "$CONFIG" "Botpack.CTFGame" "InitialBots" "8"
## DOM ##
ini_set "$CONFIG" "Botpack.Domination" "MinPlayers" "${DOM_MIN_PLAYERS}"
ini_set "$CONFIG" "Botpack.Domination" "InitialBots" "8"
## AS ##
ini_set "$CONFIG" "Botpack.Assault" "MinPlayers" "{AS_MIN_PLAYERS}"
ini_set "$CONFIG" "Botpack.Assault" "InitialBots" "8"
## TDM ##
ini_set "$CONFIG" "Botpack.TeamGamePlus" "MinPlayers" "${TDM_MIN_PLAYERS}"
ini_set "$CONFIG" "Botpack.TeamGamePlus" "InitialBots" "8"
#
## Set MaxPlayers to Variable
ini_set "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameInfo" "MaxPlayers" "${MAX_PLAYERS}"
#
## Set Bot Difficulty 0-7 (Novice-Average-Experienced-Skilled-Adept-Masterful-Inhuman-Godlike)
ini_set "$USERCFG" "Botpack.ChallengeBotInfo" "Difficulty" "${BOT_SKILL}"
#
## Make Mutators available
#FlagAnnouncementsV2
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerPackages" "FlagAnnouncementsV2"
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerPackages" "DefaultAnnouncements"
#KickIdlePlayers
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerPackages" "KickIdlePlayers2"
#WhoPushedMe
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerPackages" "EnhancedItems"
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerPackages" "WhoPushedMe"

##Make Mods available
#BunnyTrack
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerPackages" "BTPPUser"
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerPackages" "CountryFlags3"
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerPackages" "BTPlusPlusPublicUTBT_beta3"
#ChaosUT
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerPackages" "UTChaosMap"
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerPackages" "ChaosUTRHUD"
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerPackages" "ChaosUT"
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerPackages" "ChaosUTMiscMuts"
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerPackages" "ChaosGames"

#MonsterHunt
ini_add_array_value "$CONFIG" "Engine.GameEngine" "ServerPackages" "MonsterHunt"

# Map rotation scripts
if [ -n "${MAP_ROTATION}" ]; then
    echo "${MAP_ROTATION}" | tr ',' '\\n' > System/MapList.txt
fi
##---------------------------------------------
## SERVER START ##
## Depends on architecture specified in variable
##---------------------------------------------

SV_START="${MAP}.unr?Game=${GAME_TYPE}?mutator=${MUTATORS}"
LOGFILE="$HOME/Logs/server-$(date +'%Y%m%d_%H%M%S').log"
INI="$HOME/UT.ini"
USERINI="$HOME/UTUser.ini"
#
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/container/System
#
echo "Starting UT99 ${ARCHITECTURE}-bit Linux Dedicated Server"
if [ "${ARCHITECTURE}" -eq 64 ]; then
    ./System64/ucc-bin-amd64 server $SV_START ini=$INI userini=$USERINI multihome=0.0.0.0 log=$LOGFILE port=${SERVER_PORT} -nohomedir
  else
    ./System/ucc-bin server $SV_START ini=$INI userini=$USERINI multihome=0.0.0.0 log=$LOGFILE port=${SERVER_PORT} -nohomedir
fi
EOF

chmod +x ut99_start.sh

echo "----------------------"
echo "Installation complete."
echo "----------------------"
